    "id:400001,\

    logdata:'Matched Data: %{MATCHED_VAR}',\

    phase:1,\
    block,\

    msg:'Blocked access to known sensitive filename',\
    severity:'CRITICAL',\
    logdata:'Matched Data: %{MATCHED_VAR}',\
    tag:'application-multi',\
    tag:'file-access',\
    tag:'sensitive-file'"

Function GetValuesForDateInterval(ws As Worksheet, _
                                  startDate As Variant, _
                                  endDate As Variant) As Double
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim dataArr As Variant
    Dim currentDate As Variant
    Dim val As Variant
    
    Dim valForMaxDate As Variant
    Dim valForMinDate As Variant
    Dim foundMax As Boolean, foundMin As Boolean
    
    ' Validate input dates
    If startDate > endDate Then
        GetValuesForDateInterval = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        GetValuesForDateInterval = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' Read Dates and Values into Variant Array (better performance)
    ' Assumes Date in column A, Value in column B, from row 2 down to lastRow
    dataArr = ws.Range("A2:B" & lastRow).Value
    
    valForMaxDate = 0
    valForMinDate = 0
    foundMax = False
    foundMin = False
    
    For i = 1 To UBound(dataArr, 1)
        currentDate = dataArr(i, 1)
        val = dataArr(i, 2)
        
        If IsDate(currentDate) Then
            ' Handle max date = endDate
            If currentDate <= endDate Then
                If (Not foundMax) Then
                    valForMaxDate = val
                    foundMax = True
                End If
            End If

            ' Handle min date = startDate
            If currentDate < startDate Then
                If (Not foundMin) Then
                    valForMinDate = val
                    foundMin = True
                End If
            End If
        End If
        ' Exit early if both found
        If foundMin And foundMax Then Exit For
    Next i
    
    If Not IsNumeric(valForMaxDate) Then valForMaxDate = 0
    If Not IsNumeric(valForMinDate) Then valForMinDate = 0
    
    ' Return difference
    GetValuesForDateInterval = CDbl(valForMaxDate) - CDbl(valForMinDate)
End Function
